title: A parking word inside a todo's first 40 characters makes it not actionable
behavior: Todos carry BLOCKED / OWNER-ONLY / ESCALATED after a ticket prefix, not at column 0 (the anchor bug behind 488 re-prompts of 'E1 #1860 BLOCKED: ...'). Nothing is actionable, so nothing is continued.

messages.text:
# Loop Start Command
Work the session todo list one ticket at a time.

todos.content: E1 #1860 BLOCKED: waiting on the judge verdict

expected: No continuation: all three todos are parked by a marker inside their first 40 characters.
